title: PACE plan index (plan/index.csv)
description: Frozen column contract for the season routing index — one row per week across all three horizons. Table Schema (Frictionless) describing a CSV. Human-readable doc: extensions/_artefact_schema.md. Column ORDER is normative and matches the `fields` order below. Written by the Planner (plan-write, rolling); never hand-edited.

fields.name: week_id
fields.title: Week id
fields.description: <ISO-year>-W<week> (e.g. 2026-W24), or BREAK for a planned non-training span.

fields.name: horizon
fields.description: Distance from today. Only near rows carry a file.

fields.name: block
fields.description: Season block number — matches a block in plan.md.

fields.name: intent
fields.description: One-line week intent (the mid-horizon approximate-week intent, recited without opening the week file).

fields.name: load_type
fields.description: Week load shape. Empty on far rows (not yet shaped).

fields.name: volume_modifier
fields.description: Phase volume multiplier. Empty on far rows.

fields.name: status
fields.description: scheduled (mid/far) -> planned -> active -> done; or skip (e.g. BREAK). Exactly one near row is active at any time.

fields.name: file
fields.description: weeks/<week_id>.json for near rows only; empty for mid/far (no precise sessions yet).
